testimonials.quote: A bima that emits a personal and close feeling and a Rabbi who connects with their congregation as a spiritual leader and a friend.
testimonials.name: L.P.

testimonials.quote: Friday night services are short and friendly. I have brought several non-Jewish friends to give them a taste of what Jewish services are like.
testimonials.name: J.F.

testimonials.quote: The Santa Monica Synagogue, or SMS, is a hamishe, down-to-earth community of Jews from all walks of life who come together to pray, learn and grow in a kind setting.
testimonials.name: J.G.

testimonials.quote: A warm community, most welcoming, caring and supportive.
testimonials.name: R.J.

testimonials.quote: Love the SMS! I've belonged to several Temples and by far this one is the BEST!
testimonials.name: T.S.

testimonials.quote: Joining a community to welcome Shabbat together helps put the stress of the week behind us.
testimonials.name: J.K.

testimonials.quote: It is a welcoming place for young and old, singles and families.
testimonials.name: H.T.

testimonials.quote: Thank you for providing such beautiful services for us to attend during the High Holy Days in such an inclusive environment.
testimonials.name: G.D.
